newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil Tiger rebels overrun Sri Lanka army camp.
newsitem.headline: Tamil Tiger rebels overrun Sri Lanka army camp.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels overran a small army camp in Sri Lanka's eastern Batticaloa district early on Thursday, military officials said.
Casualty figures in the attack on the Vaunathivu camp were not immediately available but officials said they were believed to be high.
"The camp was overrun. The situation is not good," said an army official. "Reinforcements have been rushed to the scene."
Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte told parliament that the attack on the Vaunathivu base by Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels was still continuing.
Military officials said at least 35 soldiers of the Sixth Gajaba regiment managed to escape and had reported to nearby army camps. There was no valuable military hardware at the base, they added.
The rebels had also blown up a bridge connecting the army camp, which is on an island, to the mainland across a shallow lagoon, they said.
